Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Verify the complete end-to-end learning journey through the actual UI: Lesson access/navigation, Lesson Quiz attempts and score integrity, progress-percentage tracking, Continue Learning resume, structure-change recalculation, lifetime access, and the access-boundary guards around Lesson content — cross-checked against the current LessonController/LessonServiceImpl, which enforces no sequential-lesson locking, no enrollment check, and no server-side Lesson Quiz score verification.
Passed
Test Case Description
A freshly enrolled Learner can open the course syllabus and tap into any Lesson immediately, in any order — the app currently has no sequential-lock UI or backend gate.
column3: 1. Log in as a Learner freshly enrolled in a multi-lesson course, having completed none of its lessons. 2. Open the course's syllabus (Course Detail page). 3. Tap Lesson 3 (or any lesson other than Lesson 1) directly from the list, without opening Lesson 1 or 2 first.
column4: Lesson 3 opens immediately and its full content renders. The syllabus shows no locked indicator on any lesson — only completed lessons get a checkmark; nothing is ever shown as locked. There is no sequential-completion gate anywhere in the current LessonController/LessonServiceImpl or the syllabus UI (course_detail_page.dart) — confirm this matches actual observed behavior.
column5: - Learner freshly enrolled in a multi-lesson course; no lessons completed yet.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Marking a Lesson complete updates its status in place but does not auto-navigate — the Learner must tap a separate "Next Lesson" button to advance.
column3: 1. Open Lesson 1 (not yet completed). 2. Tap "Mark as Completed". 3. Observe the page immediately after the action finishes.
column4: The button becomes a static "Lesson Completed" badge; a lesson_progresses row is created for Lesson 1 for the caller; the sidebar shows a checkmark next to Lesson 1. The app does NOT auto-navigate to Lesson 2 — a separate "Next Lesson" button appears below the content, which must be tapped to advance.
column5: - Learner is on Lesson 1, not yet completed.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Since no sequential lock exists anywhere, deep-linking or tapping directly into a Lesson far ahead of actual progress is never blocked.
column3: 1. As a Learner who has completed no lessons yet, navigate directly to the LAST Lesson of a multi-lesson course (via the syllabus or a direct route). 2. Observe whether its content renders.
column4: The Lesson opens and its full content (video/text/quiz) renders normally — access is not blocked or redirected. This matches the confirmed no-enrollment-check, no-completion-gate behavior in LessonController/LessonServiceImpl (see itc-sheet-course-content.csv COURSECONTENT_FT01/FT04/FT05).
column5: - Learner has completed no lessons in the target course.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Skipping or failing a Lesson's attached Quiz never blocks marking the Lesson itself complete — there is no dependency between the two actions.
column3: 1. Open a Lesson that has an attached Quiz. 2. Either skip the Quiz entirely or take it and answer every question incorrectly. 3. Tap "Mark as Completed" on the Lesson itself (not the quiz).
column4: The Lesson completes successfully regardless of the Quiz being skipped or failed — Lesson completion and Quiz completion are fully independent actions with zero gating between them (BR-LRN-02).
column5: - A Lesson with an attached Quiz exists; Learner has reached it; quiz not yet attempted.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: My Learning's progress bar reflects completed-lessons / total-lessons accurately as the Learner advances.
column3: 1. Note the total Lesson count for a course. 2. Complete lessons one at a time (via "Mark as Completed" or by submitting each Lesson's quiz), checking the progress % on My Learning's Resume Learning card after each.
column4: The displayed percentage always equals round(completedLessons / totalLessons × 100, 2dp) as computed server-side in LessonServiceImpl.completeLesson, updating immediately after each completion; it never exceeds 100% or goes negative.
column5: - Learner enrolled in a course with a known total Lesson count.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: "Continue learning" resumes at the Learner's actual last-visited Lesson, falling back to the first incomplete Lesson if no cached value exists.
column3: 1. Complete a few lessons in a course, then close the app (or navigate away) mid-course without finishing. 2. Reopen the app later and tap "Continue learning" on that course's card in My Learning.
column4: The app opens directly to the Lesson cached locally as last-visited for this course (last_lesson_id_for_<courseId> in SharedPreferences). If no cached value exists, it falls back to the first not-yet-completed Lesson, or the very first Lesson if all are already complete — not necessarily back to Lesson 1.
column5: - Learner has partially progressed through a course on the same device.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Completing the final Lesson brings the enrollment to 100% / COMPLETED and unlocks the course-completion/certificate screen.
column3: 1. Complete every remaining Lesson in the course, ending with the last one.
column4: Progress reaches 100.00%; the Enrollment's status becomes COMPLETED (completedAt set); the Lesson page shows a "Claim Certificate" action in place of the "Next Lesson" button, and the course now appears under My Learning's Completed tab with a "View Certificate" button.
column5: - Learner is on the final incomplete Lesson of the course.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Learner takes a Lesson Quiz and, on Review, sees per-question correct/incorrect marking plus explanations.
column3: 1. Open a Lesson's attached Quiz via "Start" (or "Retake Quiz"). 2. Answer all questions. 3. Submit. 4. From the Attempts table below, tap "Review" on the just-submitted attempt.
column4: The review screen highlights the Learner's selected option and the actual correct option per question (green/red), with the explanation text shown when present. This works because the Lesson's questions[].correctIndex is already available to the client from the moment the Lesson loaded (see itc-sheet-course-content.csv COURSECONTENT_FT02), so no extra server round-trip is needed for the review to render correctly.
column5: - A Lesson with an attached Quiz exists.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: The Lesson Quiz score is computed entirely client-side and trusted as-is by the server — unlike the Exam module, there is no server-side recomputation from question_options.is_correct.
column3: 1. Open a Lesson Quiz and answer all questions, noting how many are deliberately correct vs incorrect. 2. Submit and read the recorded grade in the Attempts table. 3. (Cross-check, optional) Compare against SYS_FLOW_EXM_TC13, where the Exam score IS recomputed server-side.
column4: The recorded grade matches exactly what the Flutter client calculated locally (correctCount / questionCount × 10) and posted as the score field — LessonServiceImpl.saveQuizAttempt persists request.getScore() verbatim with no server-side verification against the stored answers. A tampered client could submit any score for a Lesson Quiz, unlike an Exam submission (confirmed current gap by direct code review).
column5: - Logged in; a Lesson with a quiz exists.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: There is no cap on Lesson Quiz attempts — a Learner can resubmit the same Lesson's quiz indefinitely, with every attempt kept.
column3: 1. Retake the same Lesson's Quiz two more times with different answer patterns (3 attempts total). 2. Reopen the Attempts table.
column4: All 3 attempts are listed with incrementing Attempt numbers, distinct grades, and their own submitted timestamps — none overwrite or replace a prior attempt (unlimited retakes, no server-side maximum).
column5: - At least one prior Quiz attempt exists on the Lesson (e.g. from SYS_FLOW_LRN_TC08).

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Adding a Lesson in a newly published course version recalculates an enrolled Learner's progress percentage sanely.
column3: 1. As a Learner with partial progress in a course, wait for the Trainer to add a new Lesson and publish a new version (SYS_FLOW_CRS_TC21-22), then switch to it (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC22). 2. Reopen My Learning.
column4: The progress percentage recalculates against the new total Lesson count (denominator increases); the value stays within 0-100% — it never shows an impossible number.
column5: - A new course version with an added Lesson has been published and the Learner switched to it.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Removing a Lesson the Learner had already completed does not produce an out-of-bounds progress percentage.
column3: 1. As a Learner who completed a Lesson later removed in a new published version. 2. Switch to the new version and reopen My Learning.
column4: The recalculated percentage stays within 0-100% (never negative, never over 100%), consistent with the dynamic-recalculation logic in LessonServiceImpl.completeLesson (completedLessons / totalLessons against the CURRENT version's Lesson count).
column5: - A new version with a completed Lesson removed has been published and the Learner switched to it.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Course access remains available indefinitely after purchase/enrollment, with no expiry.
column3: 1. As a Learner enrolled well in the past (or simulate a long time gap since enrollment), open the course and any previously completed Lesson.
column4: All lesson content remains fully accessible; there is no expiry date/lock applied purely due to elapsed time (lifetime access, BR-LRN-05).
column5: - An enrollment that is not recent exists.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Learner posts a question comment directly from the Lesson page while studying.
column3: 1. Open an unlocked Lesson. 2. Scroll to the comment section. 3. Enter a normal question and submit.
column4: The comment is submitted through the Rule Engine and, assuming clean text, appears immediately in the thread as APPROVED. Full moderation-outcome coverage (APPROVED/PENDING/REJECTED) is in SYS_FLOW_CMT — this case only verifies the entry point works from the Lesson page itself.
column5: - Learner has access to the Lesson.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: A Learner who is NOT enrolled in a paid course can still open its Lesson content directly, since neither the Lesson-detail endpoint nor its page checks enrollment or even authentication.
column3: 1. As a Learner NOT enrolled in a specific paid course (or fully logged out), obtain a direct link/route to one of its Lessons. 2. Open it.
column4: The full Lesson content (text/video/quiz, including quiz correct answers) renders normally with no redirect to the purchase page and no error. Confirmed current gap: LessonController.getLessonDetail only uses the caller's id to compute isCompleted (false if absent) and never checks Enrollment or requires auth at all (itc-sheet-course-content.csv COURSECONTENT_FT01). Only the course's own syllabus UI hides the tap behind an "enroll first" toast — it does not protect the underlying Lesson itself.
column5: - Learner is not enrolled in the target paid course; a direct Lesson link/id is known or guessed.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Marking a Lesson complete for a course the Learner is not enrolled in still succeeds and writes progress data.
column3: 1. As a Learner not enrolled in a course, reach one of its Lessons directly (per SYS_FLOW_LRN_TC15) and tap "Mark as Completed".
column4: 200 OK; a lesson_progresses row IS created for the caller despite having no Enrollment for that course. LessonServiceImpl.completeLesson only looks up an Enrollment to update its progress percentage (silently skipped if none exists) but never rejects the write itself (itc-sheet-course-content.csv COURSECONTENT_FT05, confirmed current gap).
column5: - Learner is not enrolled in the target course; can reach one of its Lessons per SYS_FLOW_LRN_TC15.

Lesson Learning- Quiz & Progress Trackin: Full journey: enroll, progress through every Lesson in order, reach 100% completion, then leave a review.
column3: 1. Enroll in a course (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC03). 2. Complete every Lesson in order via "Mark as Completed", tapping "Next Lesson" to advance and taking each Quiz along the way. 3. Confirm the final Lesson completion brings the course to COMPLETED and the certificate action appears. 4. Leave a course review (SYS_FLOW_ENR_TC21).
column4: Every stage transitions correctly; the Learner ends the journey at 100% progress, COMPLETED status, with a review successfully posted and reflected in the course's average rating.
column5: - Fresh enrollment in a multi-lesson course.
